name: gofr-docs
description: Search and retrieve GoFr framework documentation. Use it to answer questions about building Go microservices with GoFr, connecting datasources, observability, gRPC/GraphQL/WebSockets/Pub-Sub, deployment, and migrating from other frameworks.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across all GoFr documentation. Returns matching pages with titles, URLs, and excerpts.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'kafka consumer' or 'custom metrics'.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch one GoFr documentation page as Markdown by its site path.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the GoFr documentation sections and how many pages each contains.
